## New in this release

### Improved
- **Add to calendar** (Android): *Create calendar on the web* opens your browser app instead of the Google Calendar app. The sync request now also goes to each account, and calendars deleted on the web no longer show while the deletion waits for sync.
- Alpha only: the refresh button on *Add to calendar* shows a calendar sync debug report (sync settings per account, all calendar rows) that can be copied.

### Fixed
- The calendar list on *Add to calendar* now refreshes correctly.
